loaded-scene-physics-after-unload.reason: A scene loaded with LoadSceneAsync and a local physics mode keeps its local 3D and 2D physics scenes valid and empty after UnloadSceneAsync completes, three frames later too, in the Unity 6000.0.71f1 Editor; a created scene's are invalid after its unload (p3.unload.valid, p2.unload.valid, both.unloaded*). The LocalPhysicsMode page documents that the physics scenes go with the scene, which Unbound follows for both. Observable only through IsValid, IsEmpty and Simulate after the unload; cause not established.
